interpretation.scope: Independent-run rate sensitivity, not pure dt convergence or a matched cross-rate causal comparison. Physics, closed-loop control and sample rates change together; reset states can also differ.
interpretation.initial_state: First saved reference sample after reset, before approach; differences are b minus a, distances are nonnegative. Cross-rate prefixes are not matched or relabeled.
interpretation.normal_load: max_normal_load_n is the maximum sum of contact-normal magnitudes; not axial pull force and not wrist force.
interpretation.geometry: max_penetration_mm and straight_max_penetration are contact separation-based numerical overlap diagnostics in mm, not plastic deformation; nominal mesh envelope overlap is a separate quantity.
interpretation.whole_peak: straight_max_wrist_force_n and matched_realign_max_wrist_force_n include copied reference t=0, STOP and all executed phases; retreat fields cover retreat only.
interpretation.means: 100 ms values are maxima of full within-phase averaging windows, not single-frame peaks. reference_*_mean100ms_within_phase_n takes the maximum of the approach/insert/settle/tilt/hold phase maxima, never averaging across phase boundaries.
interpretation.policy: matched_realign_* is populated only for within-run endpoint + full-prefix matched, numerically valid, label-eligible policy outcomes. Realign recenters XY and aligns orientation. paired_costs_complete separately marks two completed uncensored clearances.
interpretation.grasp: The existing grasp gate is a relative-slip threshold, not proof the object fell out.
interpretation.pending: Only complete attempts are opened. Other case measurements and initial differences remain null; null never denotes zero or a failed withdrawal.
interpretation.source_audit: Archived source files are hashed without execution; configuration equality is reported independently from case results.
